Total number of questions—20
Payment of arrears of retired teachers
in Bareilly
†*541. SHRI B. P. SINGHAL:  Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that teachers retired
from Hafiz Siddique Punjabi Government
Higher Secondary School, Bareilly, Uttar
Pradesh in June 1990, have not been paid
their arrears even after a lapse of more than
11 years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) by when these teachers would be
paid their arrears; and
(d) the action proposed to be taken
against the persons responsible for this
criminal apathy and delay?
Indo-Chinese alliance for Chemical
fibres
*542. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS  AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether China is looking for
technological alliances with Indian
Corporates in the areas of Chemical
fibres;
(b) if so, whether the prospects of
collaboration between the two countries are
very good;
(c) whether the President, China
Chemical Fibres Association has pointed
out that there is a potential for information
regarding markets between the two
countries;
(d) if so, whether any agreement in this
regard has been reached between India
and China for alliances in chemical
technology;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the steps being taken in this regard?
Mumbai-Ahmedabad fast train
*543. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to introduce a train between
Mumbai and Ahmedabad with the speed of
400 kilometres per hour;

(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any steps in this regard, so far; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Promotion of wrestling and shooting
†*544. SHRI DEVI PRASAD
SINGH: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) what efforts are being made by
Government to promote the traditional sports
of wrestling and shooting; and
(b) what specific facilities are being
provided/are proposed to be provided for
providing education, employment and
financial assistance to the emerging young
talents in the above sports, besides imparting
better training to them?
Closure of chemical fertilizer units
†*545. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH ‘LALAN’:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
recommendations for closing down some
of the chemical fertilizer producing units;
(b) if so, from whom such
recommendations have been received;
(c) the units which are proposed to be
closed down as per those recommendations;
and
(d) what decision has been taken by
Government, so far in this regard?
Damage to wild life by toxic chemicals
and pesticides
*546. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that toxic chemicals
and pesticides are causing severe damages
to wild life;
(b) if so, the details in this regard; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government in this regard?
Pests in imported apples
†*547. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Agricultural
and Processed Food Products Export
Development Authority (APEDA) has
submitted a risk-analysis study to the
Department of Agriculture, which states that
apples imported from China contain pests
that are not found in India and can harm
Indian apples; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and what
action has been taken thereon?
Funds under National River
Conservation Programme
*548. DR. (Ms.) P. SELVIE DAS: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of amount released to
various States under National River
Conservation Programme and other
Schemes, since 1998-1999;
(b) whether Karnataka Government has
forwarded any proposal for release of funds

Drought crisis in Gujarat
3946. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Gujarat is drought prone
area; and
(b) if so, the measures taken by
Government to meet the crisis during
drought period?
Committee for export of foodgrains
3947. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up an
empowered Standing Committee in order
to take expeditious decisions on matters
relating to export of foodgrains so as to
accelerate the export of foodgrains;
(b) if so, who are the members of this
committee;
(c) whether the committee would hold
regular meetings for interaction with
exporters and their representative bodies on
the 10th of every month; and
(d) if so, to what extent setting up of this
committee has been helpful in agricultural
exports?
Availability and import of soft oils
3948. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the total availability of
popular soya, sunflower and mustered oil
has come down since the last year;
(b) if so, whether India imported 18.40
lakh tonnes of soft oils in 2000-2001;
(c) what were the total soft oils imported
during the year 2001-2002;
(d) what are the main reasons for
increasing imports of soft oils; and
(e) what efforts are being made to
improve their production during 2002-2003?
Toning up of agricultural research
3949. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the scientists engaged in
agricultural Research have alarmed
Government about the production of
foodgrains falling day by day;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any concrete steps to tone up
agricultural research in the country; and

(c) if so, the details thereof?
Agricultural production in UP
3950. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of centrally sponsored
programmes formulated and being
implemented by Government in Uttar
Pradesh to increase agricultural production
during the year 2001-2002;
(b) whether Government have fixed any
target for increasing the agricultural
production;
(c) if so, the details of achievements made
in this respect; and
(d) the details of financial assistance
granted to Uttar Pradesh for the purpose
during this period?
Agricultural research in Andhra
Pradesh
3951. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the average expenditure on
agricultural research made by the Indian
Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)
in Andhra Pradesh during the last three years,
year-wise;
(b) whether new varieties of crops were
developed to increase food production in
the State; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Visit of Central team to hailstrom
affected areas of M.P.
†3952. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a Central team
had visited hailstorm affected areas of
Madhya Pradesh;
(b) if so, when and who were members
of the team;
(c) the areas visited by that team and its
recommendations; and
(d) by when the affected farmers are
going to get Central assistance?
Demand and production of wheat and
rice
3953. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 2772 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 19th April, 2002 and state:
(a) whether it is a fact that production of
wheat and rice in the country is in surplus
of the demand; and
(b) if so, the production of wheat and
rice during 2000-2001 and 2001-2002 and
the demand for the same?
Funds for Agricultural Universities
and KVKs
3954. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state the details of allocation of
funds to various Agricultural Universities
and Krishi Vigyan Kendras through various
State Governments for the years 2000-2001
and 2001-2002?
Researches on genetic structure in
pulses
